segments.t: Pointing out that Max was begging everyone for money all day, a search of the staff lockers turns up Nagiyev's missing cash inside Max's jacket. As Max protests his innocence and Nagiyev tells Vika to call the police, Ilya steps forward and suggests they just fire Max instead.
Лавров же деньги у всех искал и спрашивал.
Что, парень, стал у богатых воровать.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
'What is this apple core doing here?' The grammar packs 'what' and 'scrap' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Лавров же деньги у всех искал и спрашивал.
'Lavrov was going around asking everyone for money earlier.' The '-l' ending on the verb meaning 'was looking for' places the action in the masculine past tense.
'Who here is Lavrov?' Notice how Russian expresses 'who' and 'Lavrov' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Max answers right away.
'I am. Right here.' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'he' without extra filler words.
Что, парень, стал у богатых воровать.
'So, kid, you started stealing from the rich?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'what' before landing on 'steal'.
'Which is all the proof we need.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'then' and finishing on 'was needed'. Max answers right away.
'I did not take your money.' Max chooses the respectful plural 'you' alongside 'money' to keep a polite distance.
'Vika, call the police.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'Vika' and 'to cause' in a few short words.
'I did not take the money!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'I' before landing on 'money'. Max answers right away.
'Maybe we can handle this without the police?' Max brings out the contrast between 'maybe' and 'we' in a few short words.
'And why is that?' Vika brings out the contrast between 'and' and 'what' in a few short words.
'Let us just fire him on the spot.' In Russian, the idea of 'let's' flows naturally into 'will fire' without extra filler words. Max answers right away.
'Go on, pack your things.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'let's' before landing on 'pack'. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Лавров же деньги у всех искал и спрашивал.
Что, парень, стал у богатых воровать.
